description: Separate evidence-index linkage mapping process name -> repo-relative path of its H12 machine-evidence artifact (scripts/l22_evidence/h12.py). Consumed by scripts/l22_evidence/generator.py's _with_h12_evidence_ref() to supply h12_evidence_ref for mechanical re-derivation WITHOUT mutating any process's tracked result.json. Hand-editing this file only changes WHICH artifact path a process points at; it can never itself force a green verdict -- verdict.h12_support_reason() independently re-validates the referenced artifact's verdict/nontrivial_sample_count/exact_match_rate/hash-freshness every time.
